Title: Public preview: Cognitive Services- Anomaly Detector now supports multivariate anomaly detection​

Body.Content:
The new multivariate anomaly detection APIs in Anomaly Detector further enable developers to easily integrate advanced AI of detecting anomalies from groups of metrics into their applications without the need of machine learning knowledge or labeled data. Dependencies and inter-correlations between different signals are now counted as key factors. The new feature protects your mission critical systems and physical assets, such as software applications, servers, factory machines, spacecrafts, or even your business, from failures with a holistic view.

Read the blog.​

Try Anomaly Detector.
